title: Kotlin-Based Migration Graph Ordering for Memory-Safe FOSS Projects
topic: Supporting FOSS projects to transition to memory safe tech
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Supporting open-source projects to adopt memory-safe programming requires a deterministic migration order that respects inter-project dependencies while guaranteeing safety invariants. We present a lightweight Kotlin library that constructs a topological ordering of projects using Kahn's algorithm, indexed by a balanced search structure for efficient dependency lookup. The algorithm preserves the acyclicity invariant and guarantees a height-balanced search tree with a maximum height of $\log_2 N$, yielding $O(\log N)$ point and range search, and $O(\log N)$ insertion and deletion. Formal invariants are proven in Section~\ref{sec:invariants}. Static analysis on an AMD EPYC 7763 platform confirms the structural complexity: 93 SLOC and a single function block. The source code is publicly available at \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/kotlin-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261120_130233_supporting_foss_projects_to_tr}.
